subject: Prepay rollforward and VAT liaison for annual committed spend
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme-analytics.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: acct-payments@acme-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Annual prepay invoicing cadence + VAT lines (Acme / Redwood)

Hi Stephanie,

We're finalizing our budgeting and want to lock the invoicing cadence for the $750,000 committed prepay under ACME-DEAL-2197. Finance has asked for a rollforward schedule (invoice dates, amounts, drawdown ledger entries) and clear VAT (US vs EU) line items so they can set up automated remittance.

Key asks:
- Can you provide the proposed invoice dates and amounts (we prefer quarterly invoices but are open) plus the drawdown mapping to usage buckets?
- We need VAT-friendly invoice line items. Acme will reclaim EU VAT where applicable; provide VAT registration/ownership text to include on the invoice.
- Remittance instructions (wire details) and the redlined PO acceptance process so our AP team can map to your invoices.

Target timeline: would like the first invoice before year-end (late Nov/early Dec). Can you confirm?

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Head of Finance Operations
Acme Analytics

[Attachment: ACME_budget_outline.pdf (PDF)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual prepay invoicing cadence + VAT lines (Acme / Redwood)

Hi Maria — thanks, and congrats on closing the committed spend. I put together a proposed rollforward and the initial invoice plan attached (2026-prepay-rollforward.xlsx). High level summary below:

Proposed cadence (option A - preferred):
- Invoice 1 (prepay) — 2026-12-15 — $375,000 (50%) — credited to committed ledger line CP-2026-Q4
- Invoice 2 — 2027-03-15 — $187,500 (25%) — drawdown to usage pool A
- Invoice 3 — 2027-06-15 — $93,750 (12.5%) — usage pool B
- Invoice 4 — 2027-09-15 — $93,750 (12.5%) — final sweep/true-up

Notes:
- We can do a single upfront invoice if you prefer (full prepay). The rollforward gives clearer monthly drawdown entries for your GL.
- VAT: For US invoicing we will show no VAT; for EU-registered entities we will include VAT lines. Please confirm the billing entity and VAT registration number so we can populate the invoice header.

Attachments included: 2026-prepay-rollforward.xlsx (schedule + draft invoice stub), wire_instructions.pdf (Redwood remittance).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm cadence (quarterly or full prepay) and the billing entity/VAT number.
2) If quarterly, we'll issue the first invoice 2026-12-15 and route remittance to the bank in the wire_instructions.pdf.

I'll loop in Finance Ops for tax/VAT wording once you confirm the billing entity.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Revenue Operations (Seller)
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: 2026-prepay-rollforward.xlsx (Excel)]
[Attachment: wire_instructions.pdf (PDF)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Annual prepay invoicing cadence + VAT lines — need VAT text + invoice sequence

Team — forwarding Acme's ask. Key points below; please advise on exact VAT phrasing and whether we should issue via Redwood Inc (US) or Redwood Europe Ltd for reclaim purposes. Also confirm the invoice numbering scheme so Acme can map to their PO ACME_PO_4321.

Highlights:
- Committed prepay $750k; customer prefers quarterly split but will accept single prepay.
- They need VAT line items for EU-reclaim in the invoice header. If we bill from Redwood Europe Ltd we must include our EU VAT reg no. If billed from Redwood Inc, VAT = 0 and they will account via reverse charge (if applicable).
- Attachments: sample-invoice_US-VAT.xlsx will be our template.

Action items:
- Marcus: confirm recommended billing entity + VAT verbiage, and provide sample invoice header text.
- Ben: confirm invoice numbering pattern (we should reserve A-INV-2026-XXXX sequence) and PO mapping guidance.
- Laura: update collections cadence for quarterly drawdown (notify AR queue).

Thanks — need responses by COB Friday so we can send final to Acme and get their PO signed.

Cheers,
Steph

> On Tue, Nov 3, 2026 at 11:05 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Annual prepay invoicing cadence + VAT lines — need VAT text + invoice sequence

Stephanie / team — reviewed. Recommendation: bill from Redwood Europe Ltd only for invoices going to Acme entities with an EU billing address and a valid VAT number. Otherwise bill from Redwood Inc with VAT = 0 and add reverse-charge text for EU customers without VAT registration.

Suggested invoice header (for EU-registered Acme):
Redwood Europe Ltd
VAT Reg: GB999888777
Invoice No: A-INV-2026-4321
Customer VAT ID: [insert Acme VAT no]
Description: Prepayment for committed inference services (ACME-DEAL-2197)
VAT handling for our AR system:
- Sequence: A-INV-2026-XXXX (set aside range 4300-4399 for Acme)
- Ledger mapping: CP-2026-Q4 -> Prepay liability account 2401; drawdowns -> revenue recognition account 4003 per month.

Attached sample invoice stub and the PO mapping table. Ben — please reserve invoice numbers in the AR queue and confirm.

Thanks,
Marcus
Finance — Revenue Ops

[Attachment: sample-invoice_US-VAT.xlsx (Excel)]
